annotations.title: Build a site from a description

description: Designs and publishes a complete, modern one-page website from a plain-language description, using the same AI builder as https://deed.page/build. Inputs: prompt (required, up to 2000 characters), and optional slug and token. Takes about a minute. Returns the same fields as a publish (url, slug, version, and token on the first anonymous build) plus build {title, sections, seconds}. The result is an ordinary site: edit and republish it with the same token like any other site. Limits: 3 builds per token per hour and 10 per day, plus per-address limits; over a limit returns rate_limited with retry_after. When the builder is at capacity it returns busy with retry_after. Each build uses one of the token owner's AI credits (every account has 1 free build; Hobby and Pro add monthly credits); with none left it returns credits_exhausted with message_for_user and a $1 pack offer (checkout plan ai_pack) to show your human, and nothing is spent. Never pay without their approval. Content policy: https://deed.page/acceptable-use.

prompt.description: What the site is for: business or project, audience, sections, tone, colors. 8-2000 characters.

slug.description: Optional slug matching ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$. A new slug, or one this token owns. Omit for a random slug.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.
